backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four features related to restoring the HellCod MC heading, creating an ImageSlideshow component, positioning it in HeroSection, and rendering 6 Minecraft server screenshots as static assets.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, hooks, contexts, and styling with details about theme system, animations, and layout structure.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with base layer defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes using OKLCH color space, including semantic color tokens for UI components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with viewport meta tag, page title 'HellCod MC Lifesteal Website', root div, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component wrapping all sections with ThemeProvider and rendering CustomCursor, MouseLightEffect, Stars, Moon, Header, and page sections (Hero, Gameplay, Rewards, Shop, CTA, Footer).
frontend/src/components/CallToAction.tsx: CTA section with scroll animations featuring glassmorphic cards, Discord join button, motivational messages about dominating the server, and a fresh server launch notice.
frontend/src/components/CloudsBackground: Empty file placeholder for clouds background component.
frontend/src/components/CustomCursor.tsx: Custom cursor component with touch device detection that renders morphing cursor and trailing effect only on pointer devices, responding to hover and click states.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with three-column grid layout displaying brand info, server IP, Discord link, copyright notice, and caffeine.ai attribution with dynamic year and hostname.
Gameplay features section with scroll-triggered fade-in animations displaying four feature cards (Combat, Hearts, Competitive, Strategic) in a responsive grid with hover effects.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed navigation header with logo, desktop/mobile menus, theme toggle, and Discord link. Includes smooth scrolling to page sections and responsive hamburger menu.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero section displaying server title, image slideshow, and server IP with copy-to-clipboard functionality. Features magnetic button effects and ripple animations on interaction.
frontend/src/components/ImageSlideshow.t: Auto-advancing image carousel with manual navigation controls and dot indicators. Displays 6 Minecraft server build images with smooth transitions and hover-revealed navigation arrows.
frontend/src/components/IntroSequence.ts: Empty component file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/Moon.tsx: Renders a glowing moon decoration in the top-right area, visible only in dark theme mode.
frontend/src/components/MouseLightEffect: Creates a purple radial gradient light effect that follows the mouse cursor, active only in dark theme mode with optimized RAF-based position updates.
frontend/src/components/RewardsSection.t: Displays server rewards, achievements, and statistics with animated cards showing top player rewards, seasonal events, and player/battle stats. Uses scroll-triggered animations.
Shop section showcasing premium items and crate keys with pricing, plus a notice directing users to Discord for purchases. Features scroll-triggered fade-in animations.
frontend/src/components/SiteLogo.tsx: Empty component file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/Stars.tsx: Generates 70 randomly positioned twinkling star decorations across the viewport, visible only in dark theme mode with pixelated rendering.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: React component that renders a theme toggle button with animated sun/moon icons and day/night labels, using the ThemeContext to switch between light and dark modes.
frontend/src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx: React context provider that manages theme state (light/dark), persists preference to localStorage, and applies theme class to document root.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages an ICP backend actor with authentication, automatically invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes based on identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file for future React Query hooks when backend functionality is implemented.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollAnimation.ts: Custom React hook using IntersectionObserver to detect when an element enters the viewport and trigger visibility state for scroll-based animations.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system for light/dark themes featuring purple color scheme, gradient backgrounds, glassmorphism effects, and smooth transitions.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the theme with custom OKLCH colors (purple, night/day gradients), border radius variables, shadows (glass, glow effects), and animation utilities.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing a Minecraft Lifesteal server website (HellCod MC) with glassmorphism design, animated elements, server information, and required Minecraft build screenshots.
